jobs.title: Freelance Tester (Faroe Islands) – Global Payment Research ($100/hr)
jobs.description: We’re Testlio , a global software testing company that helps businesses make sure their apps, websites, and digital services work correctly for real people around the world. We’re currently looking for someone based in the Faroe Islands to help us test an international payment service. What are we testing? When companies send money internationally, they need to make sure the payment reaches the right type of local bank account and that important information, such as the amount, date, and payment reference, appears correctly. That’s where you come in. Our client will send a small test payment to your local Faroe Islands bank account . Your role is simply to: Receive the international transfer. Check the amount, date, and payment reference. Take screenshots and/or a short video confirming the payment arrived. Share the requested evidence with our testing team. You will not send money, make a purchase, transfer money back, or use your own funds. The purpose is simply to confirm that an international payment reaches a real Faroe Island bank account correctly. Requirements Currently based in Faroe Island . Have a local Faroe Island bank account in local currency . Comfortable providing the banking details needed to receive the transfer. Comfortable providing screenshots/video as evidence. Willing to sign a consent form before your information is shared with the payment provider. No specific device is required, and we’ll provide instructions for the task. Time & Payment The active testing takes approximately 1 hour total . The bank transfer itself may take up to 2 business days to arrive. $18 USD/hour $100 USD completion bonus after successfully completing the testing requirements How To Test This You will be asked to create an account on our website in order to access the testing materials and track any issues with the app/payment transfer. This stage takes approximately 30 minutes, and can later be used to find additional freelancer work on our website. Interested? Apply through this posting and answer a few short eligibility questions. If you meet the requirements, our team will contact you with the next steps. #LI-REMOTE
